item.title: Adjusting Your Routine During Injury Recovery
item.description: Injury recovery often reshapes daily life in ways that feel unfamiliar and restrictive. Tasks that once felt automatic may require planning, patience, and flexibility. Adjusting routines is less about giving things up and more about reorganizing energy, expectations, and priorities.
